question: Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?

details.reason: Complete results differ from Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 0.0
details.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.transaction_id) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.gas_station_id = T2.gas_station_id WHERE T2.country = 'CZE' AND TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') >= '2012'
